title: Notify admins when new site messages are created
requirements: Set up a Cloud Function or equivalent backend trigger to send notifications whenever a new site message is created.
Request browser notification permissions only after the user has passed the /admin authentication gate, never on public pages.
Ensure admin users can receive and test notifications without exposing the permission prompt to unauthenticated visitors.
Document the notification delivery path, permission UX, and any required Firebase or browser configuration.
notes:
DONE (awaiting review). FINAL ARCHITECTURE = Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) Web Push. Upgraded from the initial foreground-only Notification API approach, which could not deliver alerts when the tab was closed or the phone was asleep.

IMPLEMENTATION:
(1) functions/index.js — added `onDocumentCreated` Firestore trigger `onSiteMessageCreated` on `inquiries/{messageId}` (region us-central1). On each new site message it (a) writes a derived audit doc to the `notifications` collection: { type:'site_message', title, body, link:'/admin', sourceCollection, sourceId, read:false, createdAt:serverTimestamp() }, and (b) calls `sendPushToAdmins()` which uses `getMessaging().sendEachForMulticast()` to every token in the `adminTokens` collection, pruning invalid/expired tokens. Extracted pure helper `buildMessageNotification(data)` and constants INQUIRIES_COLLECTION / NOTIFICATIONS_COLLECTION / ADMIN_TOKENS_COLLECTION.
(2) firestore.rules — `notifications/{id}`: `allow read, update: if isAdmin(); allow create, delete: if false;`. `adminTokens/{token}`: `allow create, update: if isAdmin(); allow read, delete: if false;` (tokens are secrets; only the Admin SDK reads/prunes them).
(3) src/lib/notifications.js (NEW) — SSR-safe, side-effect-free Notification API helpers: isNotificationSupported(), getNotificationPermission(), requestNotificationPermission(), showNotification({title,body,tag,onClick}), showTestNotification(). No-ops when the Notification API is unavailable.
(4) src/lib/push.js (NEW) — FCM helpers: isPushSupported(), isPushConfigured(), registerPushToken(adminEmail) (registers the service worker, calls getToken() with VAPID_KEY, persists the token to `adminTokens`), onForegroundMessage(handler). Uses VITE_FIREBASE_VAPID_KEY and SERVICE_WORKER_PATH='/firebase-messaging-sw.js'.
(5) src/lib/firebase.js — exported the `app` instance so push.js can reuse it.
(6) public/firebase-messaging-sw.js (NEW) — background service worker using the compat SDK (v10.12.2); firebase.initializeApp(...), messaging.onBackgroundMessage() to display OS notifications when no tab is open, and a notificationclick handler that deep-links to /admin.
(7) public/manifest.webmanifest (NEW) + index.html — PWA manifest (start_url '/admin', display 'standalone') and apple-mobile-web-app-* meta tags so iOS 16.4+ admins can install to Home Screen and receive Web Push.
(8) src/pages/Admin.jsx — auth-gated notification UX. Added notifPermission/notifError + pushSupported/pushStatus/pushError state, a read-only permission probe on mount (does NOT prompt), an FCM support probe, and an `onForegroundMessage` effect (active only while authenticated) that renders an in-tab desktop notification for messages received while the dashboard is open. '🔔 Enable Notifications' requests permission, registers this device for FCM push, then fires a test; '🔔 Send Test' re-fires a test; '✓ Push enabled on this device' shows once the token is registered. Controls hidden when unsupported.
(9) .env.example — added VITE_FIREBASE_VAPID_KEY with documentation.
(10) README.md — rewrote the 'Admin Notifications for New Site Messages' section with the FCM delivery-path diagram, auth-gated permission UX, security rules, VAPID configuration, and iOS PWA install steps.

CLEANUP (post-upgrade): removed the now-redundant foreground `onSnapshot` desktop-notification effect from Admin.jsx (and the seenNotificationIds/notificationsInitialized refs + unused onSnapshot/limit/useRef imports). FCM's onForegroundMessage now covers the open-tab case and the service worker covers the closed-tab case, so each message is surfaced exactly once (no double notifications). The `notifications` collection is retained purely as a persisted audit feed.

AUTH-GATING (key requirement): the permission prompt is only reachable from the authenticated Admin dashboard — src/lib/notifications.js and src/lib/push.js are imported exclusively by Admin.jsx, and the prompt is only triggered by an explicit button click rendered after the /admin auth gate passes. Unauthenticated visitors see only the login form; no permission request or push registration runs.

VALIDATION: `node --check functions/index.js` OK; `npx eslint src/pages/Admin.jsx src/lib/push.js src/lib/notifications.js src/lib/firebase.js` clean; `npm run build` succeeded (16 prerendered pages). Pre-existing lint errors in functions/index.js (Node globals) and unrelated components are not introduced by this task.

REQUIRED CONFIG: set VITE_FIREBASE_VAPID_KEY (Firebase Console → Project Settings → Cloud Messaging → Web Push certificates) in .env.local and GitHub Actions Variables; then `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,functions`.
